newsitem.title: USA: SunTrust profit fueled by asset growth.
newsitem.headline: SunTrust profit fueled by asset growth.

text.p: SunTrust Banks Inc said strong growth in earning assets and slower growth in expenses combined to boost third-quarter net income to a record $155.6 million, up 8.3 percent from a year ago.
Per-share earnings rose 11.1 percent to $0.70 per share from $0.63 per share in the 1995 third quarter.
Average shares outstanding were 226.52 million in the latest quarter, down 1.7 percent from a year ago.
SunTrust said loans as of September increased 12.7 percent to $33.8 billion.
Net charge-offs for third quarter were $27.9 million or an annualized rate of 0.34 percent of average loans.

Nonperforming assets decreased 3.5 percent from 1996's second quarter and at September 30, 1996, totaled $239.5 million, their lowest level since the fourth quarter of 1988. The reserve for loan losses was $724.7 million or 2.14 percent of loans.
The provision for loan losses totaled $30.0 million for the quarter and $81.2 million year-to-date.
Net interest income in the third quarter was $464.2 million, an increase of $34.1 million from the third quarter of 1995.
The quarterly net interest margin was 4.38 percent, a decrease of five basis points from its second-quarter 1996 level.
Non-interest income, led by trust and investment fees, grew $14.6 million or 8.0 percent for the quarter.
Quarterly non-interest expense increased 7.3 percent from a year ago, primarily due to increased personnel expense associated with the company's growth initiatives.
